productConcept.name: Neon Reverie
productConcept.description: A vaporwave and synthwave streaming platform for lo-fi, synthwave, and ambient music discovery — designed as a neon dreamscape you inhabit, not a catalog you scroll.
productConcept.rationale: The phosphor-haze design system is explicitly a vaporwave/synthwave aesthetic — soft teal-cyan (#63cabe) and periwinkle-purple (#b79cff) neon accents on white, Exo 2 700 display + Russo One uppercase + Space Mono body, 0.8s dreamy easing, 3D perspective grid floor utility, and a concept_by_image that explicitly describes 'Neon Reverie: A Vaporwave Lo-Fi Streaming Platform'. A music streaming platform is the natural product for this system — particularly one emphasizing atmospheric, unhurried listening over algorithmic discovery. The 'enter the dreamscape' philosophy aligns with the glassmorphism nav, neon glow hover states, and CRT warmup motion system.

heroTreatmentReason: Provided explicitly by caller — light-dominant site with white hero control zone, dark dreamscape as lower hero band and contrast beats
animationDecision: motion-tokens — non-trivial durations (0.8s base, 1.5s enter), named easing curves, 6 keyframe definitions including neonGlowPulse and vaporwaveScanlineSweep, concept_by_video defines CRT warmup sequence and per-section motion choreography
contentSource: none — no content/ directory found in design system
